anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential inactivity or malfunction.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss and win rate, suggesting inactivity or issues with trade execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Evaluate AI system's configuration and ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Review active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning as intended and generating trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Assess the AI system's operational status and troubleshoot any issues preventing it from learning and generating opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Analyze the trading system's performance and ensure that active strategies are correctly implemented and operational.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring trading strategies are active and effective is crucial for maintaining platform profitability.
